svg.title: Production deployment
svg.desc: One VPS hosts separate ingress, application, Face, and application-database Compose projects.

text.tspan: One VPS hosts separate ingress, application, Face, and application-database Compose projects.
Core sends queued pushes to Expo
Public edge blocks /internal/* and Keycloak /admin/*. Database, Redis, and management listeners are private.
Encrypted application and Keycloak database backups are copied off the VPS. Release images are tagged by commit.
